stem:
Soham opens a perfume bottle in one corner of a closed room. Soon the smell reaches the far wall.

Why does this gas have no fixed shape or fixed volume?

options.text: Its particles move freely in all directions with negligible attraction, so the gas spreads to fill the available space.
Its particles attract each other strongly and stay in fixed positions.
Its particles move freely but only along one fixed path.
Its particles are locked in a lattice that can stretch to any size.

teacher.key_rationale: Gas particles move freely in all directions with negligible attractions, so a gas has no fixed shape or volume and fills available space. Fixed positions describe a solid, not a gas.
